integrity.euler_basis: Compactly supported Euler characteristic localizes to the fixed locus of an algebraic C* action, and projectivity identifies compactly supported and ordinary Euler characteristic.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for 1111.6202 gives the first submission date 2011-11-26.
integrity.fixed_point_basis: A base-(d+1) diagonal cocharacter gives distinct weights to all degree-d monomials; unique factorization then leaves exactly x_i^d and x_i^(d-1)x_j.
integrity.object_basis: Oeding--Raicu define the tangential variety as the union of embedded tangent lines/spaces and treat the Veronese specialization explicitly.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The archival paper's Mathematics Subject Classification line begins with 14L30 and the paper is an algebraic-geometry treatment of the same tangential family.
integrity.tangent_space_basis: The tangent space at a Veronese point [ell^d] is the projectivization of ell^(d-1)V, so every tangential point has representative ell^(d-1)m.

scientific_limitations: The theorem computes ordinary Euler characteristic only, not individual Betti numbers, intersection cohomology, degree, or mixed Hodge structure.
The theorem is restricted to Veronese degree at least three; the quadratic tangential variety has a different fixed-point pattern.
Because the localization proof is short, an older unindexed or folklore formulation remains possible.
title: Euler characteristic of a higher Veronese tangential variety
